status: working scientific architecture; not final thesis freeze

thesis.working_title: Mathematical Physics of Sustainable Infrastructure Resilience
thesis.precise_formulation: Equity-Constrained Viability of Coupled Power–Water–Transportation–Solid-Waste Systems with Dynamic Interfaces under Climate Stress

formal_propositions.P1: dynamic interfaces materially alter resilience/viability geometry relative to static coupling
formal_propositions.P2: interface identifiability materially affects reliability of inferred viability
formal_propositions.P3: interface/system timescale ratios govern validity of static approximations
formal_propositions.P4: sustainability/equity constraints deform viability beyond technical-operability constraints
formal_propositions.P5: recovery geometry contains information not captured by viability alone
formal_propositions.P6: waste–drainage–flood feedback shifts coupled P-W-T-SW resilience boundaries
formal_propositions.P7: reduced models for decisions must preserve or conservatively bound viability conclusions

historical_hypothesis_crosswalk.H3: separate viability-boundary interface-criticality hypothesis; no exact P1-P7 equivalent
historical_hypothesis_crosswalk.H7: optional/legacy target; no exact current P1-P7 equivalent
